description: This file defines the FavoritesController class, which manages favorite articles by exposing endpoints to add or remove favorites. It utilizes dependency injection, mediates commands, and incorporates authorization schemes.

classes.name: FavoritesController
classes.description: Controller handling favorite article actions, with methods to add and remove favorites based on article slugs.

methods.name: FavoriteAdd
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add an article to favorites, uses mediator to send 'Add' command.

methods.name: FavoriteDelete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove an article from favorites, uses mediator to send 'Delete' command.
